emerging_technology: Multimodal generative AI for short-form social video creation and content governance
intended_application: Create draft 15-60 second TikTok and Instagram marketing videos from approved product assets, with human review before publication and provenance/disclosure controls for AI-generated media
organization: A mid-sized consumer brand considering a short-video pilot
capabilities_constraints: The organization reports an existing marketing team and budget but provides no evidence about approval workflow, rights management, security review, provenance retention, training, incident ownership or measurement capability
risk_consequence_context: Public-facing synthetic media may create brand, rights and disclosure consequences
management_question: Is the organization ready to authorize public use?
additional_context: This case intentionally withholds the operating evidence needed for a firm readiness determination.
